Dunlin-235B has clearly stronger benchmarks and internal evals across the board, including the most relevant one here: Creative Generation (84.7 vs. 78.8, a gap well outside run-to-run variance). It also leads on Arena-Hard (90.6 vs. 81.4) and IFEval, which matter for following the specific request well.

The task preference notes for both models only concern harm-adjacent/distasteful material, which doesn't apply to this wholesome creative prompt, so they don't affect the decision. With nothing pulling toward Lapwing, I routed to the more capable model for the creative task.
